messages.subject: Accessing column name in colwise
parts:
Hi all, I am wondering whether the following pattern is supported by any plyr function in a more elegant way:
(I end up using the pattern quite a bit to link data from two dataframe/structures):

setNames(lapply(names(df), function(colName) {
    someFunction(df[[colName]], anotherDataStructure[[colName]])
  }), names(df))

Its not horrible, but feels pretty inelegant (iterate through names, and then set names at the end.. ew!)
Basically, I guess the question is whether there is a way to acces the column-name in colwise... or something similar.

cheers,
--p
